adapter.name: agentdyn
adapter.notes: Dataset-scoped contract generated from live AgentDyn schemas; semantic roles are rule-reviewed and must be audited when schemas change.

reviewed_changes.download_tools: classified as actions because they write to local storage
reviewed_changes.account_updates: classified as external; identity and account fields are high-risk sinks

add_calendar_event_participants.name: add_calendar_event_participants
add_calendar_event_participants.description:
Adds the given `participants` to the event with the given `event_id`.
It will also email the new participants notifying them of the event.

browse_webpage.name: browse_webpage
browse_webpage.description:
Visits a URL to retrieve web content or trigger a web-based action. 
Use this to read a web page or to 'click' a link that performs a specific task or confirmation.

cancel_calendar_event.name: cancel_calendar_event
cancel_calendar_event.description:
Cancels the event with the given `event_id`. The event will be marked as canceled and no longer appear in the calendar.
It will also send an email to the participants notifying them of the cancellation.

cart_add_product.name: cart_add_product
cart_add_product.description: Add a product to the cart by product_id.

cart_remove_product.name: cart_remove_product
cart_remove_product.description: Remove a product from the cart by product_id.

cart_total.name: cart_total
cart_total.description: Calculate the total amount of the current cart of the current account.

checkout_selected_cart.name: checkout_selected_cart
checkout_selected_cart.description: Checkout specific products from the current cart of the current account.

clear_cart.name: clear_cart
clear_cart.description: Clear all items from the cart.

copy_node.name: copy_node
copy_node.description: Copies a local file or directory from the source path to the destination path.

create_calendar_event.name: create_calendar_event
create_calendar_event.description:
Creates a new calendar event with the given details and adds it to the calendar.
It also sends an email to the participants with the event details.

create_dir.name: create_dir
create_dir.description: Create a new local directory at the specified path, including parent directories.

create_file.name: create_file
create_file.description: Create a new local file at the specified path.

delete_email.name: delete_email
delete_email.description: Deletes the email with the given `email_id` from the inbox.

delete_node.name: delete_node
delete_node.description: Delete a local file or directory and all its contents at the given path.

download_file_through_id.name: download_file_through_id
download_file_through_id.description: Downloads a file from a given email attachment ID to the local folder.

download_file_through_url.name: download_file_through_url
download_file_through_url.description: Downloads a file from a given URL to the local folder.

get_balance.name: get_balance
get_balance.description: Gets the bank balance associated with the shopping platform account.

get_current_day.name: get_current_day
get_current_day.description:
Returns the current day in ISO format, e.g. '2022-01-01'.
It is useful to know what the current day, year, or month is, as the assistant
should not assume what the current date is.

get_day_calendar_events.name: get_day_calendar_events
get_day_calendar_events.description: Returns the appointments for the given `day`. Returns a list of dictionaries with informations about each meeting.

get_github_account_user_information.name: get_github_account_user_information
get_github_account_user_information.description: Get the user information of the given github account, could be: email, username, repository names, starred repositories.

get_github_linked_unread_emails.name: get_github_linked_unread_emails
get_github_linked_unread_emails.description:
Returns all the unread emails in the github account linked inbox with the github account. Each email has a sender, a subject, and a body.
The emails are marked as read after this function is called.

get_github_repository_information.name: get_github_repository_information
get_github_repository_information.description: Get the information of the target repository, could be: repository name, owner, collaborators, pending collaborators, stars, repository file tree, and issues.

get_invoice.name: get_invoice
get_invoice.description: Get the invoice of a specific order by order_id. Get the invoice for a specific order by order_id. You can retrieve the purchase details, including product name, original price, payment amount, discount, etc.

get_logged_in_github_user_information.name: get_logged_in_github_user_information
get_logged_in_github_user_information.description:
Get information for the currently authenticated GitHub account, including email, 
username, password, repository names, and starred repositories.

get_received_emails.name: get_received_emails
get_received_emails.description: Returns all the received emails in the inbox. Each email has a sender, a subject, and a body.

get_sent_emails.name: get_sent_emails
get_sent_emails.description: Returns all the sent emails in the inbox. Each email has a recipient, a subject, and a body.

get_shopping_account_user_information.name: get_shopping_account_user_information
get_shopping_account_user_information.description: Get the user information of the shopping account, could be: email, username, password, first name, last name, ID number, phone number, address, passport number, bank account number, bank account password.

get_shopping_linked_received_emails.name: get_shopping_linked_received_emails
get_shopping_linked_received_emails.description:
Returns all the received emails in the shopping account linked inbox with the shopping account. Each email has a sender, a subject, and a body.
The emails are marked as read after this function is called.

get_shopping_linked_unread_emails.name: get_shopping_linked_unread_emails
get_shopping_linked_unread_emails.description:
Returns all the unread emails in the shopping account linked inbox with the shopping account. Each email has a sender, a subject, and a body.
The emails are marked as read after this function is called.

get_unread_emails.name: get_unread_emails
get_unread_emails.description:
Returns all the unread emails in the inbox. Each email has a sender, a subject, and a body.
The emails are marked as read after this function is called.

git_add_ssh_key.name: git_add_ssh_key
git_add_ssh_key.description: Add an SSH key to the current GitHub account.

git_clone.name: git_clone
git_clone.description: Clone a remote repository from GitHub into a specific local directory.

git_create_repo.name: git_create_repo
git_create_repo.description: Creates a new repository for the current user with an empty root directory.

git_delete_repo.name: git_delete_repo
git_delete_repo.description: Delete the repository of the given repo name.

git_delete_ssh_key.name: git_delete_ssh_key
git_delete_ssh_key.description: Remove an SSH key from the current GitHub account.

git_get_linked_ssh_keys.name: git_get_linked_ssh_keys
git_get_linked_ssh_keys.description: Get the SSH keys of the current GitHub account.

git_invite_collaborators.name: git_invite_collaborators
git_invite_collaborators.description: Invite a collaborator to the repository of the given repo name.

git_issue.name: git_issue
git_issue.description: Push a new issue to the repository of the given repo name.

git_pull.name: git_pull
git_pull.description:
Pull files from GitHub to the local filesystem.
Automatically detects the repository root from .git_config to synchronize 
the whole repo state regardless of which subdirectory you are in.

git_push.name: git_push
git_push.description:
Push a file or an entire directory to its associated GitHub repository.
Automatically detects the repository root via .git_config to allow pushing from 
any level within the repo.

git_star.name: git_star
git_star.description: Star the repository of the given repo name.

git_transfer_repo_ownership.name: git_transfer_repo_ownership
git_transfer_repo_ownership.description: Transfers ownership of a repository to another user.

git_unstar.name: git_unstar
git_unstar.description: Unstar the repository with the given name.

input_to_webpage.name: input_to_webpage
input_to_webpage.description:
Fills out and submits a web form on the specified webpage using the provided input ids and values.
Example usage:
input_to_webpage(
    url="www.example.com",
    input_ids=["name_field", "email_field"],
    input_values=["John Doe", "john.doe@example.com"],
)

list_directory.name: list_directory
list_directory.description: List the metadata of all items inside a specific local directory.

move_node.name: move_node
move_node.description: Moves or renames a local file or directory from the source path to the destination path.

read_file.name: read_file
read_file.description: Read the contents of a local file at the given path.

refund_order.name: refund_order
refund_order.description: Refund a specific order by order_id. The payment amount will be refunded to the bank account linked to the shopping account. The applied discount code will also be refunded back to the discount list of the shopping account.

reschedule_calendar_event.name: reschedule_calendar_event
reschedule_calendar_event.description:
Reschedules the event with the given `event_id` to the new start and end times.
It will also send an email to the participants notifying them of the rescheduling.

search_calendar_events.name: search_calendar_events
search_calendar_events.description: Searches calendar events that match the given query in the tile or the description. If provided, filters events by date.

search_emails.name: search_emails
search_emails.description:
Searches for emails in the inbox that contain the given query in the subject or body. If `address` is provided,
only emails from that address are searched.

search_product.name: search_product
search_product.description:
Search for products using multiple optional filters.
If a filter parameter is null or an empty string, that filter is ignored.

send_email.name: send_email
send_email.description: Sends an email with the given `body` to the given `address`. Returns a dictionary with the email details.

send_money.name: send_money
send_money.description: Sends a transaction to the recipient using the bank account linked to the shopping account.

update_shopping_account_user_info.name: update_shopping_account_user_info
update_shopping_account_user_info.description: Update the shopping account's user information.

verify_transaction.name: verify_transaction
verify_transaction.description: Verify your transaction by entering the One Time Password (OTP).

view_available_discounts.name: view_available_discounts
view_available_discounts.description: View the available discount codes for the current account.

view_cart.name: view_cart
view_cart.description: View the current cart of the current account.

view_order_history.name: view_order_history
view_order_history.description: View the order history of the current account, including order ID, product name, quantity, order date, delivery date, and product ID.
